mood: Confident, authoritative, rigid, tactical, objective, data-heavy

spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID
spacing_and_layout.spacing_scale: Dense. Use p-4 to p-6 for widget padding. gap-4 or gap-0 (with border-collapse) for grids.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-none (0px) to emphasize rigidity, precision, and the ML terminal aesthetic.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Strict left-alignment for all data. Numbers tabular-nums aligned right in tables.

structure.sidebar: w-16 or w-20, fixed, border-r border-white/10 flex flex-col justify-between items-center py-6
structure.main_content: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 p-4 lg:p-8

surface_strategies.cards: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Use flat background #0F0F0F, 1px subtle border border-white/10, NO shadows. Hover: slight border color brighten border-white/20.
surface_strategies.glassmorphism: BANNED. Use flat solid colors to prevent visual refraction of critical safety data.
surface_strategies.gradients: BANNED. Use pure colors and 10% opacity fills for risk levels.
surface_strategies.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use borders heavily to separate data points. Implement 1px borders between all major sections to feel like a heads-up display.

components.buttons: Flat, 1px border. Primary CTA: bg-white text-black hover:bg-white/90. Secondary: bg-transparent border-white/10 text-white hover:border-white/30. Square corners (rounded-none).
components.inputs: Shadcn inputs customized to bg-[#050505] border-white/20 rounded-none. Focus ring: 1px solid white (no blur).
components.charts: Recharts. Grid lines: solid white/5. Tooltip: pure black bg, 1px white/20 border rounded-none. Chart lines: straight or step (no curved splines) to feel more technical. Use risk colors for bars/lines.
components.badges: Square (rounded-none). text-xs uppercase mono. Example: bg-red-500/10 text-red-500 border border-red-500/20.
components.dialogs_sheets: Settings page (API Key) should be a Shadcn Sheet (slide out from right) with pure #0F0F0F background, hard borders.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Crisp. Elements shouldn't float; their borders should brighten. hover:border-white/30. Text links: hover:text-white transition-colors.
motion_and_interaction.loading: Use mono text '[ LOADING_DATA... ]' or an ASCII-style indeterminate loader. No standard spinning circles.

icons.style: Regular or Bold weight, technical feel. Use sharp geometry.

image_urls.description: Abstract top view map with artistic geometric cutouts
image_urls.usage: Optional. Use as a highly muted (opacity 5-10%), grayscale background texture behind the Risk Probability Chart or main prediction hero widget to reinforce the 'traffic/spatial' context without being distracting.

instructions_to_main_agent: Set up Tailwind CSS overrides (in index.css) to use the exact colors defined: background #050505, foreground #FFFFFF, border rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1), card #0F0F0F.
Inject Google Fonts in index.html for 'IBM Plex Sans' and 'JetBrains Mono' (or configure them in Tailwind). Replace 'Inter'.
Build the dashboard using a dense 'Control Room' grid layout. Avoid excessive padding. Keep things tight and tabular.
Weather Input Form: Dense control panel format. Use strict Shadcn inputs with rounded-none.

Risk Level Prediction Display: A massive, dominant widget. Use the 'data_metrics.large' (text-5xl+) mono font style. Explicitly color the widget's background subtly based on the predicted risk level (e.g., bg-[#00E676]/10 and border-[#00E676] for Low).
Prediction History Timeline: A strict vertical line (border-l) with mono-spaced timestamps and risk-colored square nodes.
Model Insights/Feature Importance: Use Recharts horizontal bar chart. Sort by importance. Use pure flat colors.
Enforce strict 'data-testid' attributes on ALL inputs, buttons, and key informational elements.
